steps.title: JOIN и отчёты
steps.content:
## Basic Join

- **`INNER JOIN`**, **`LEFT JOIN`**, `HAVING` после группировки.
- Отчёты по оценкам — `CASE` + сортировка.
- HackerRank contest schema: `Hackers`, `Submissions`, `Challenges`.

content.description:
Сумма `POPULATION` городов стран, у которых `NAME` **начинается с `P`** (таблицы `CITY`, `COUNTRY`).

[HackerRank: Population Census](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/population-census/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE COUNTRY(CODE TEXT PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, CONTINENT TEXT NOT NULL, REGION TEXT NOT NULL, SURFACEAREA REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT SUM(C.POPULATION) FROM CITY C JOIN COUNTRY CO ON C.COUNTRYCODE = CO.CODE WHERE CO.NAME LIKE 'A%';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT SUM(C.POPULATION) FROM CITY C JOIN COUNTRY CO ON C.COUNTRYCODE = CO.CODE WHERE CO.NAME LIKE 'P%';

content.description:
Имена городов (`City`) в **Africa** (`CONTINENT = 'Africa'`). Сортировка по `City`.

[HackerRank: African Cities](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/african-cities/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE COUNTRY(CODE TEXT PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, CONTINENT TEXT NOT NULL, REGION TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY.NAME FROM CITY JOIN COUNTRY ON CITY.COUNTRYCODE = COUNTRY.CODE WHERE COUNTRY.CONTINENT = 'Asia' ORDER BY CITY.NAME;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY.NAME AS City FROM CITY JOIN COUNTRY ON CITY.COUNTRYCODE = COUNTRY.CODE WHERE COUNTRY.CONTINENT = 'Africa' ORDER BY CITY.NAME;

content.description:
По каждому `CONTINENT`: средняя `POPULATION` городов, **округлённая вниз** до целого. Сортировка по `CONTINENT`.

[HackerRank: Average Population of Each Continent](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/average-population-of-each-continent/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE COUNTRY(CODE TEXT PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, CONTINENT TEXT NOT NULL, REGION TEXT NOT NULL, SURFACEAREA REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CO.CONTINENT, AVG(C.POPULATION) FROM CITY C JOIN COUNTRY CO ON C.COUNTRYCODE = CO.CODE GROUP BY CO.CONTINENT ORDER BY CO.CONTINENT DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CO.CONTINENT, CAST(AVG(C.POPULATION) AS INTEGER) FROM CITY C JOIN COUNTRY CO ON C.COUNTRYCODE = CO.CODE GROUP BY CO.CONTINENT ORDER BY CO.CONTINENT;

content.description:
Для каждого студента с `MARKS > 0` верните **`Grade`**, **`NAME`**. Шкала: `MARKS >= 90 → 1`, `>= 80 → 2`, `>= 70 → 3`, `>= 60 → 4`, `>= 50 → 5`, `>= 40 → 6`, `>= 30 → 7`, `>= 20 → 8`, `>= 10 → 9`, `< 10 → 10`. Сортировка: `Grade` возр., `NAME` возр.

[HackerRank: The Report](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/the-report/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STUDENTS(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, MARKS INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT MARKS, NAME FROM STUDENTS WHERE MARKS > 0 ORDER BY MARKS DESC, NAME;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN MARKS >= 90 THEN 1
    WHEN MARKS >= 80 THEN 2
    WHEN MARKS >= 70 THEN 3
    WHEN MARKS >= 60 THEN 4
    WHEN MARKS >= 50 THEN 5
    WHEN MARKS >= 40 THEN 6
    WHEN MARKS >= 30 THEN 7
    WHEN MARKS >= 20 THEN 8
    WHEN MARKS >= 10 THEN 9
    ELSE 10
  END AS Grade,
  NAME
FROM STUDENTS
WHERE MARKS > 0
ORDER BY Grade ASC, NAME ASC;

content.description:
Студенты с `MARKS >= 70`: `Name` и метка **`The Minion(s)`**, иначе **`The Coffee Bean(s)`**. Сортировка по `Name`.

[HackerRank: Top Competitors](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/top-competitors/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STUDENTS(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, MARKS INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT NAME, 'The Coffee Bean(s)' FROM STUDENTS ORDER BY NAME;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT NAME,
  CASE WHEN MARKS >= 70 THEN 'The Minion(s)' ELSE 'The Coffee Bean(s)' END
FROM STUDENTS
ORDER BY NAME;

content.description:
Связь `Wands.id = Wands_Property.magic_wand_id`. Группировка по `(W.code, WP.age, идеальность: WP.min_safety_level <= WP.max_safety_level)`. Для **идеальных** палочек — `MIN(W.coins_needed)`, для **неидеальных** — `MAX(W.coins_needed)`; колонки **`code`**, **`age`**, **`coins`**. Сортировка: `code`, `age`, `coins`.

[HackerRank: Ollivander's Inventory](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/ollivanders-inventory/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Wands(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code INTEGER NOT NULL, coins_needed INTEGER NOT NULL, power INTEGER NOT NULL, age INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Wands_Property(magic_wand_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, age INTEGER NOT NULL, is_rare INTEGER NOT NULL, min_safety_level INTEGER NOT NULL, max_safety_level INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT W.code, WP.age, MIN(W.coins_needed) FROM Wands W JOIN Wands_Property WP ON W.id = WP.magic_wand_id GROUP BY W.code, WP.age ORDER BY W.code, WP.age;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT W.code, WP.age,
  CASE WHEN WP.min_safety_level <= WP.max_safety_level THEN MIN(W.coins_needed) ELSE MAX(W.coins_needed) END AS coins
FROM Wands W
JOIN Wands_Property WP ON W.id = WP.magic_wand_id
GROUP BY W.code, WP.age, WP.min_safety_level <= WP.max_safety_level
ORDER BY W.code, WP.age, coins;

content.description:
Для каждого участника с **положительной** суммой баллов: `hacker_id`, `name`, `total_score`. Сортировка: `total_score` убыв., `hacker_id` возр.

[HackerRank: Contest Leaderboard](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/contest-leaderboard/problem)
content.starterCode: SELECT h.hacker_id, h.name, SUM(s.score) AS total_score FROM Hackers h JOIN Submissions s ON h.hacker_id = s.hacker_id GROUP BY h.hacker_id, h.name ORDER BY total_score;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT h.hacker_id, h.name, SUM(s.score) AS total_score
FROM Hackers h
JOIN Submissions s ON h.hacker_id = s.hacker_id
GROUP BY h.hacker_id, h.name
HAVING SUM(s.score) > 0
ORDER BY total_score DESC, h.hacker_id ASC;
